$description: NetworkGraph (platform/charts/NetworkGraph.jsx, network-graph.css; library wave 9, lane A): its component tokens. Node colors are the categorical data-viz steps by group (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

network-graph-node-size.$description: Network graph: the size of a node's dot, given as its radius (SVG r; 24px across). A size, not a corner (owner, dot-radius-names-34).

network-graph-node-outline.$description: Network graph: the ring of the surface around a node, so edges stop short of it.

network-graph-node-outline-width.$description: Network graph: the width of the ring around a node.

network-graph-label-font-family.$description: Network graph: node and edge labels are names: the UI font.

network-graph-label-font-size.$description: Network graph: a node label's size.

network-graph-label-offset.$description: Network graph: the distance from a node's center to its label under it.

network-graph-label-halo-color.$description: Network graph: the halo under labels, so they stay readable over edges.

network-graph-label-halo-width.$description: Network graph: the width of the labels' halo.

network-graph-edge-color.$description: Network graph: an edge and its arrowhead.

network-graph-edge-dash.$description: Network graph: the dash and gap of a dashed edge (a second kind of link).

network-graph-edge-label-text.$description: Network graph: an edge's label (the relationship), secondary text.

network-graph-edge-label-font-size.$description: Network graph: an edge label's size.

network-graph-active-edge-color.$description: Network graph: the edges of the node in focus.

network-graph-active-edge-width.$description: Network graph: the width of the active node's edges.

network-graph-active-outline.$description: Network graph: the ring of the node in focus.

network-graph-active-outline-width.$description: Network graph: the width of the active node's ring.

network-graph-active-label-font-weight.$description: Network graph: the label of the node in focus.
